title: Concept: Transfer amount rendered as an editable field
description: An input that carries the amount the client will submit in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The amount is a business decision the server must own, so an editable field invites a tampered value that only a downstream check can catch.
applicability: Deployments that render an input that carries the amount the client will submit into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The amount is a business decision the server must own, so an editable field invites a tampered value that only a downstream check can catch.
